description.value: Trees Organic Coffee is a Vancouver-area cafe chain that has been operating since 1996, known for its in-house roasted organic coffee and award-winning homemade cheesecakes voted best in Vancouver. The Gilmore location in Burnaby is one of 13–14 locations across the region. The menu extends beyond coffee to include sandwiches, baked goods, and a lunch selection, making it a practical stop for a mid-ride meal.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 96m. Total: 4 spaces.
